from pathlib import Path
import json
import re

ROOT = Path.cwd()


def read(path):
    return (ROOT / path).read_text()


def write(path, content):
    target = ROOT / path
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(content)
    print(f"updated {path}")


def replace_required(path, old, new):
    source = read(path)
    if old not in source:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Required anchor not found in {path}: {old[:140]!r}")
    write(path, source.replace(old, new, 1))


def replace_regex(path, pattern, replacement, flags=re.S):
    source = read(path)
    next_source, count = re.subn(pattern, replacement, source, count=1, flags=flags)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Required regex not found in {path}: {pattern}")
    write(path, next_source)


def patch_package_json():
    path = "package.json"
    data = json.loads(read(path))
    data.setdefault("scripts", {})["test:budget-reset"] = "node --test tests/atomic-budget-reset.test.mjs"
    write(path, json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")
